node.statement: Apply lem-maincb-stage2-raw-extension to the Stage-2 datum just furnished and choose one resulting extended D_2*t-isomorphism v_+:M_{r+1}->A_R with ||v_+(I_{M_{r+1}})-u_{A_R}||<=D_2*t. Construct the composite Stage-2 raw-call record whose literal output is u_2:=v_+; this is a definition inside the newly constructed record, not an identification with a prior opaque output. Since D_2*t<=D_*t, lem-maincb-extended-inclusion-monotone makes this same u_2 an extended D_*t-isomorphism, in particular an extended D_*t-inclusion, and the unit estimate weakens to D_*t.
